Per-AC Wikipedia infoboxes for Bameng (8), Rumgong (32), Pangin (35), Liromoba (27)
notes: Districts are the current 27 districts of Arunachal Pradesh per the Arunachal Pradesh (Reorganisation of Districts) Act 1980 as amended to 2024; the newest are Bichom (HQ Napangphung, carved from West and East Kameng; Act passed 7 Feb 2024, inaugurated 7 Mar 2024) and Keyi Panyor (HQ Yachuli, carved from Lower Subansiri; inaugurated 1 Mar 2024). Earlier additions: Kra Daadi (2015), Siang (2015), Lower Siang (2017), Kamle (2017), Pakke-Kessang, Lepa Rada, Shi Yomi (all 30 Aug 2018). Itanagar Capital Complex has its own Deputy Commissioner but is not a district under the Act, so 13 Itanagar and 14 Doimukh go to Papum Pare. Seat -> district follows the Wikipedia AC list (district column, updated for the new districts), checked against the 2008 Delimitation Order's circle lists. Where sources disagree: 8 Bameng is put in East Kameng (the Order gives it Bameng, Khenewa and Lada circles; only the Lada side went to Bichom in 2024, and Bameng town stays in East Kameng; the Wikipedia AC list says Bichom, the Bameng article and the Arunachal West page say East Kameng) - uncertain, and with this choice Bichom holds no seat of its own; 16 Yachuli -> Keyi Panyor (the district is exactly the Yachuli AC area; the LS page still says Lower Subansiri); 32 Rumgong and 35 Pangin -> Siang (Siang district, 2015, took Rumgong, Kaying, Pangin, Boleng circles; the LS pages still say West Siang / Upper Siang). Other straddles: 25 Raga takes 29 Daporijo-circle villages of Upper Subansiri but its Raga circle and HQ are Kamle; 27 Liromoba (Liromoba, Darak circles; HQ West Siang) - West Siang; 36 Nari-Koyu - Lower Siang (2017). Regions are the two Lok Sabha seats (2008 Order Table B): Arunachal West = ACs 1-33 (33), Arunachal East = ACs 34-60 (27), assigned per seat via seatRegions; their district lists are empty because Siang district (32 Rumgong West, 35 Pangin East) and Lower Siang (28 Likabali West, 36 Nari-Koyu East) are split between the two. Seat names follow ar-seats.txt numbering (ECI 2024 spellings, e.g. 12 Pakke-Kasang, 26 Damporijo, 57 Borduria-Bogapani, 60 Pongchao-Wakka). Bichom district (2024) holds no seat here: 8 Bameng is kept in East Kameng (its headquarters and most of its circles; the Bameng article and the Delimitation Order), so Bichom is not listed.
